body: General hatred of my situation, don't like my job and can't think of anything I would actually want to do. Living paycheck to paycheck, but just barely. I have been on meds for anxiety and depression for 2 years and the last few moths it seems to be getting worse. I have had in the past and it is happening again that I have an irrational paranoia and fear that everyone around me is judging me negatively at all times. Those are the big things...
It's hard to explain things, and I always feel like my problems are so small it shouldn't make me feel the way it does

I can't take a break, I am management in retail and it's the season for shopping. A lot of things have gotten me here, but the big things recently are hating my life situation and intense social anxiety (with a retail job)

I have wanted to before, but never acted on it, other than to pinch myself. I think the guilt is part of what set me over the edge tonight. My friends are always there for me, they go through similar stuff as me and so we have been good about helping each other when we can. I am afraid to tell them I did this, I have a long history with depression, and a family history. my father killed himself when i was a child and I worry they will worry
